metadata.title: $\mathfrak{sl}(2)$- and $\mathfrak{osp}(1|2)$-invariant multidifferential operators
metadata.abstract: We determine the dimension of the space of $\mathfrak{sl}(2)$-invariant (n)-ary differential operators on weighted densities for arbitrary weights, including the singular cases in which the usual elimination procedure breaks down. The proof relies on the strong Lefschetz property established by Stanley \cite{s} and Watanabe \cite{w}. We also investigate the corresponding problem in the super case.

analysis.progressType: 不变多重微分算子的维数
analysis.workSummary: 作者求任意权（含通常消元失效的奇异权）下，weighted density上的sl(2)不变n元微分算子空间维数。证明借助Stanley与Watanabe的strong Lefschetz性质，并研究osp(1|2)的对应super问题。
analysis.breakthrough: 补入一般权下容易被传统消元遗漏的退化情形。
analysis.limitations: 摘要对super情形仅称研究对应问题，不能自动赋予同样完整分类结论。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
